summary: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-anvil2 9.0.4 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at preinstall
details: Version 9.0.4 of this React chat UI package adds an undocumented preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases into an OS temp directory and uses that freshly-fetched alternate runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` employing string-array rotation, hex-identifier renaming, and character-code reassembly; no source counterpart or build recipe for it is shipped in the tarball, and it is not referenced by README.md or CHANGELOG.md. Neither the preinstall script, setup.mjs, math_init.js, nor a Bun dependency is documented — CHANGELOG.md's most recent entry is v8.0.0 and describes only React component changes. Running package code through a second, downloaded language runtime at `npm install` bypasses Node-based install-time inspection, and the payload's opacity prevents verification of what it does on the installer's host. The version jump plus injected preinstall dropper into an otherwise React-component package is consistent with a compromised-publisher supply-chain injection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
